# Menen Student Assistant

Menen is the Ethiopian high-school learning platform. Study full subject notes, practice quizzes, take ESLCE and national exam past papers, and track your progress — online or fully offline.

## What it is

- Study guides and subject notes for Ethiopian high school students.
- Section-level quizzes and full practice exams.
- ESLCE national exam past papers and modules (premium).
- Progress tracking and report cards.
- Works in the browser, as an Android APK, or 100% offline after one-time content download.

## Key pages

- Home: https://menen-oshs-app.pxxl.click/
- About / contact: https://menen-oshs-app.pxxl.click/about

## Access modes

- **Browser**: open the site, no install needed.
- **APK**: native Android app.
- **Offline**: download the app + content once (~300–500 MB), then study anywhere without internet.

## FAQ

- Q: How much storage does offline mode need?
  A: About 300–500 MB including the app and your grade's notes and basic quizzes. Everything then works without an internet connection.

- Q: Will I lose my progress if I study offline?
  A: No. Progress is stored locally and syncs with your account when you are back online.

- Q: How do I get updates?
  A: Browser and APK versions update automatically online; offline content ships via periodic app updates.

- Q: Is my data secure?
  A: Accounts use secure sign-in. Offline study data stays on your device. Premium exam/ESLCE content is delivered separately after purchase.
